name: Located
description: Where someone or something is: lives in, office at, kept at.

relation.how_many: Neither end: a person has a home and an office at once, and a place holds as many things as it holds. What is one at a time is one *label* — one home, one office — which is `one_of_a_label`, and it is the right instrument because the limit belongs to the word the user said and not to being located anywhere at all.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What the user calls this relation, in their words.

what_to_say: where exactly, and for what stretch of time
